causes.label: Type of detergent
remedies: Switch to a lower sudsing detergent brand and follow instructions on package.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Type of detergent"

causes.label: Very soft water
remedies: Try less detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Very soft water"

causes.label: Too much detergent
remedies: Measure your detergent carefully.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load, or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Too much detergent"

causes.label: Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected
remedies: Make sure hose connections are tight at faucets and the washing machine.
Make sure the end of the drain hose is correctly inserted in and secured to the drain.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Fill hoses or drain hose is improperly connected"

causes.label: Household drain may be clogged
remedies: Check household plumbing.
You may need to call a plumber.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Household drain may be clogged"

causes.label: Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source
remedies: Tighten hoses at the faucets and turn the water off after each use.
Check condition of the fill hoses; they may need replacement after 5 years.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Constant water pressure to the fill hoses at the water source"

causes.label: Using too much detergent in washer
remedies: Use less detergent.
Use less soap if you have soft water, a smaller load, or a lightly soiled load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Using too much detergent in washer"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off or improperly connected
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on and make sure hoses are connected to correct faucets.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Water supply is turned off or improperly connected"

causes.label: Water valve screens are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and remove the water connection hoses from the upper back of the washer.
Remove screens and use a brush or toothpick to clean the screens in the machine.
Reinstall screens, reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Water valve screens are stopped up"

causes.label: House water heater is not set properly
remedies: Make sure house water heater is delivering water at 120°F.–140°F.(48°C.–60°C.).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "House water heater is not set properly"

causes.label: Drain hose is kinked or improperly connected
remedies: Straighten drain hose and make sure washer is not sitting on it.
Top of drain outlet should be less than 8 ft. above floor.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Drain hose is kinked or improperly connected"

causes.label: The washer normally pauses between washing steps
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "The washer normally pauses between washing steps"

causes.label: Washer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure cord is plugged securely into a working outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Washer is unplugged"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn both hot and cold faucets fully on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: Controls are not set properly
remedies: Make sure all selections have been made.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Controls are not set properly"

causes.label: Lid is open
remedies: Close lid and press START/PAUSE.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Lid is open"

causes.label: Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown
remedies: Check house circuit breakers/fuses.
Replace fuses or reset breaker.
Washer should have separate outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Circuit breaker/fuse is tripped/blown"

causes.label: Colored spots            Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
Pretreat stain and rewash.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Colored spots            Incorrect use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort whites or lightly colored items from dark colors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Grayed or yellowed       Not enough detergent clothes
remedies: Use more detergent (especially with larger loads).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Grayed or yellowed       Not enough detergent clothes"

causes.label: Hard water
remedies: Use a water conditioner like Calgon brand or install a water softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Hard water"

causes.label: Water is not hot enough
remedies: Make sure water heater is delivering water at 120°F.–140°F.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Water is not hot enough"

causes.label: Washer is overloaded
remedies: Select load size to match clothes load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Washer is overloaded"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort clothes by color.
If fabric label states wash separately, unstable dyes may be indicated.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Lint or residue on       Clothes are air or line dried clothes
remedies: If you do not dry your clothes with a clothes dryer, your clothes may retain more lint.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Lint or residue on       Clothes are air or line dried clothes"

causes.label: Incorrect sorting
remedies: Separate lint producers from lint collectors.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Incorrect sorting"

causes.label: Washing too long
remedies: Wash small loads for a shorter time than larger loads.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Washing too long"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Load clothes no higher than the top row of holes in the washer tub.
Make sure load size selector matches clothes load size.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Overloading"

causes.label: Incorrect use of fabric softener
remedies: Check fabric softener package for instructions and follow directions for using dispenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Incorrect use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Pilling                  Result of normal wear on poly-cotton blends and fuzzy fabrics
remedies: While this is not caused by the washer, you can slow the pilling process by washing garments inside out.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Pilling                  Result of normal wear on poly-cotton blends and fuzzy fabrics"
